spec.rawSql: SELECT relname AS "Tabela", ROUND(pg_total_relation_size(relid) / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2) AS "Tamanho (MB)" FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(relid) DESC LIMIT 15;
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT setting::int FROM pg_settings WHERE name='max_connections'), 2) AS "Uso %" FROM pg_stat_activity;
SELECT setting::int AS "Max connections" FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'max_connections';
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'idle';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Conexões ativas" FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Total conexões" FROM pg_stat_activity;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE 1
    END AS "Status",
    
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 'OK - Nenhum IP não permitido'
        ELSE 'ALERTA - IP não permitido detectado'
    END AS "Situação",

    COUNT(*) AS "Conexões não permitidas"

FROM (
    SELECT
        application_name,
        client_addr
    FROM pg_stat_activity
    WHERE datname = 'rodoeverton'
      AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()
      AND (
            split_part(client_addr::text, '.', 1) || '.' ||
            split_part(client_addr::text, '.', 2) || '.' ||
            split_part(client_addr::text, '.', 3)
          ) <> ALL (
            ARRAY[
                '192.168.1',
                '136.248.94',
                '10.212.134'
            ]
          )
) sub;

SELECT
    usename AS "Usuário",
    client_addr::text AS "IP",
    application_name AS "Aplicação",
    COUNT(*) AS "Conexões"
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE datname = 'rodoeverton'
  AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()
GROUP BY
    usename,
    client_addr,
    application_name,
    state
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;

SELECT
    pid AS "PID",
    usename AS "Usuário",
    host(client_addr) AS "IP",

    CASE
        WHEN application_name LIKE '%|%' THEN
            split_part(application_name, '|', 1)
            || ' - ' ||
            split_part(application_name, '|', 2)
        ELSE
            application_name
    END AS "Aplicação",

    query_start AS "Início",

    NOW() - query_start AS "Duração",

    ROUND(
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - query_start))::numeric,
        2
    ) AS "Duração (s)",

    wait_event_type AS "Tipo Espera",
    wait_event AS "Espera",

    LEFT(query, 1000) AS "Query"

FROM pg_stat_activity

WHERE datname = 'rodoeverton'

  AND state = 'active'

  AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()

  AND NOW() - query_start >= INTERVAL '5 seconds'

ORDER BY query_start ASC

LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    pid AS "PID",

    usename AS "Usuário",

    host(client_addr) AS "IP",

    split_part(application_name, '|', 1)
    || ' - ' ||
    split_part(application_name, '|', 2)
    AS "Aplicação",

    state AS "Estado",

    query_start AS "Início",

    NOW() - query_start AS "Duração",

    CASE
        WHEN query ~* '\mDROP\M' THEN 'CRÍTICO - DROP'
        WHEN query ~* '\mTRUNCATE\M' THEN 'CRÍTICO - TRUNCATE'
        WHEN query ~* '\mDELETE\M' THEN 'ALTO - DELETE'
        WHEN query ~* '\mALTER\M' THEN 'ALTO - ALTER'
        WHEN query ~* '\mGRANT\M|\mREVOKE\M' THEN 'ALTO - PERMISSÃO'
        WHEN query ~* '\mUPDATE\M' THEN 'MÉDIO - UPDATE'
        WHEN query ~* '\mINSERT\M' THEN 'MÉDIO - INSERT'
        WHEN query ~* '\mCREATE\M' THEN 'MÉDIO - CREATE'
        ELSE 'OUTRO'
    END AS "Risco",

    LEFT(query, 1000) AS "Comando"

FROM pg_stat_activity

WHERE datname = 'rodoeverton'

  AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()

  AND query ~* '\m(INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|TRUNCATE|ALTER|DROP|CREATE|GRANT|REVOKE)\M'

ORDER BY query_start DESC

LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN application_name IS NULL OR application_name = '' THEN 'Consulta BI'
        WHEN application_name ILIKE 'DBeaver%' THEN 'DBeaver'
        ELSE split_part(application_name, '|', 1)
    END AS "Aplicação",

    split_part(client_addr::text, '.', 1) || '.' ||
    split_part(client_addr::text, '.', 2) || '.' ||
    split_part(client_addr::text, '.', 3) AS "Rede (IP)",

    COUNT(*) AS "Conexões",

    CASE
        WHEN (
            split_part(client_addr::text, '.', 1) || '.' ||
            split_part(client_addr::text, '.', 2) || '.' ||
            split_part(client_addr::text, '.', 3)
        ) IN (
            '192.168.1',
            '136.248.94',
            '10.212.134'
        )
        THEN 'Permitido'
        ELSE 'NÃO PERMITIDO 🚨'
    END AS "Status"

FROM pg_stat_activity

WHERE datname = 'rodoeverton'
  AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()
  AND client_addr IS NOT NULL

GROUP BY
    CASE
        WHEN application_name IS NULL OR application_name = '' THEN 'Consulta BI'
        WHEN application_name ILIKE 'DBeaver%' THEN 'DBeaver'
        ELSE split_part(application_name, '|', 1)
    END,

    split_part(client_addr::text, '.', 1),
    split_part(client_addr::text, '.', 2),
    split_part(client_addr::text, '.', 3)

ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (
            split_part(client_addr::text, '.', 1) || '.' ||
            split_part(client_addr::text, '.', 2) || '.' ||
            split_part(client_addr::text, '.', 3)
        ) IN (
            '192.168.1',
            '136.248.94',
            '10.212.134'
        )
        THEN 0
        ELSE 1
    END DESC,

    "Conexões" DESC;
